- Master bill: we will split charges across three GL codes (Product / Research / Sales). Can you confirm you can accept a split master bill and provide the file format you prefer? We typically send a spreadsheet.
- Rooming list: I’ll send the attendee assignments by next Tue (1/19). Please confirm the rooming template and whether you can pre-program keycards for access to floors 4/5 (exec floors) and the conference wing.
- Shuttle: need a shuttle for arrivals on 3/21 at 08:30AM and a return at 6:30PM. Approx headcount 28, with 4 heavy luggage pieces (we’ll confirm manifest).

Attachments: draft rooming_template.csv (blank) — please confirm you can consume this for the master bill join.

Best,
